subtitle: MuffinStore Jailed, but with a proper UI.
localizedDescription:
PancakeStore
MuffinStore Jailed, but with a proper UI. iOS 16.4 and later.
Latest Release • Support Server • Website • Original Project (by mineek)

[!WARNING]
Use this tool at your own risk! You may lose app data, and other damage could occur.

Features

Downgrade most applications available on the App Store (you will need to input the link to the app store app).

How do I downgrade an application?

The application you want to downgrade will need to be uninstalled. If you want to keep the app data, offload the app first.
Install PancakeStore using your preferred sideloading method.
Log in your Apple ID, and click "Send 2FA Code." If you can, try sending a 2FA code before logging in (there should be this in the settings app, but it was removed in iOS 18?).
In most cases, you should get a popup. Accept the new login, and copy the verification code into the 2FA field. If you don't get that popup, type six random numbers into the 2FA field. I assume this works because you must've logged into MuffinStoreJailed/PancakeStore at a different time. 
Click "log in" and go to the App Store.
Find the application you're looking for, click the share button, and copy the link.
Go back to PancakeStore and click the clipboard button.
Click "Downgrade App" and wait patiently!

Troubleshooting

App crashes when trying to log in: You likely input the wrong 2FA code. Kill the app from the app switcher and try again.
App doesn't progress when clicking "log in": You likely input the wrong Apple ID and/or Password. Kill the app from the app switcher and try again.
I don't receive a 2FA code when clicking "Authenticate": Type six random numbers into the field and log in. This likely works because you had logged into MuffinStoreJailed or PancakeStore in the past, even on a different device.
The app crashes when I try to downgrade: You likely did not purchase (download) the app in the past. Download the app beforehand and remove it, or purchase it from another device.
